environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or filtering rules configured on the ALB. The application runs as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account with read-write access to /var/lib/app/users.db. Route53 public DNS record points to the ALB.

config.alb: internet-facing, default listener rules, no WAF association
config.database: SQLite3 local file, appuser has rw access
